capability.summary: Lint one JavaScript/TypeScript target with ESLint native JSON output and a fixed explicit config
capability.description: Runs ESLint with JSON formatting, disables normal config lookup, and supplies the config path from `SGAR_ESLINT_CONFIG` or `/opt/eslint.config.mjs`. It reports rule findings without `--fix` and therefore does not rewrite source files.
capability.problem_space: Read-only ESLint rule analysis for one existing JavaScript/TypeScript-compatible target under one explicit config; not source formatting, automatic fixing, compilation, type checking, or Python linting.

env_requirements: an ESLint configuration file must exist at the path in SGAR_ESLINT_CONFIG, or at /opt/eslint.config.mjs when that environment variable is unset
constraint.io_signature: Input: one required existing file or path accepted by ESLint; output: JSON execution envelope containing parsed ESLint JSON findings and process metadata or an explicit execution error.
accepted_inputs: an existing JavaScript or TypeScript source file supported by the configured ESLint setup
an existing path or pattern-free directory argument that the installed ESLint accepts as one target
constraint.output_shape: Completed lint (ESLint exit 0 or 1): {status: "success", tool: "eslint", target: string, exit_code: 0|1, result: array|object|null, stdout: string|null, stderr: string|null}; parsed ESLint native JSON is stored in result and stdout becomes null, while exit 1 represents lint findings. Other ESLint exits use the same keys with status="tool_error" and propagate the actual exit code. Missing target/executable/120-second timeout: {status: "error", tool: "eslint", message: string}, exiting 2/3/4. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON.
limitations: fixed `--no-config-lookup --config` behavior ignores ordinary ESLint config discovery and uses only `SGAR_ESLINT_CONFIG` or `/opt/eslint.config.mjs`
does not pass `--fix` or `--fix-dry-run`, so it neither changes files nor returns formatter-oriented fixed source
exposes no rule, extension, ignore, cache, warning-threshold, or formatter options through inputs
requires ESLint and the selected config to be available, uses a fixed 120-second timeout, and does not truncate captured output

output_contract.description: JSON execution envelope containing parsed ESLint lint findings, target, exit code and stderr/stdout metadata; source files are not fixed.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: lint JavaScript or TypeScript with ESLint JSON output
check ESLint rule violations using the S-GAR explicit config
negative_intents: format or automatically fix JavaScript or TypeScript source
run a generic syntax compiler or TypeScript type checker
lint Python with flake8, Ruff, Black, or Bandit
